# ESF-1 Balance Sheet, U.S. Treasury Exchange Stabilization Fund, as of March 31, 1989.
# The capital account of the ESF carries a fixed nominal capital of $200 million.
# Total capital and liabilities as of March 31, 1989 per ESF-1 balance sheet.

nominal_capital_millions = 200.0      # $200 million nominal capital
total_capital_liabilities_millions = 11942.0  # total capital and liabilities, $ millions

# convert to billions
nominal_capital_b = nominal_capital_millions / 1000.0
total_b = total_capital_liabilities_millions / 1000.0

diff_b = abs(nominal_capital_b - total_b)

print(f"[{round(nominal_capital_b,3)}, {round(diff_b,3)}]")
